title: Broken Symmetry / State Change Becomes Measurable

source_refs.author: Comparative visual composition analysis
source_refs.title: Symmetry, deviation, and state evidence
source_refs.cultural_context: Architecture, cinema, photography, and stage composition

observed_structure: a symmetrical relation is established clearly enough to be remembered
one side changes in occupancy, orientation, material, or timing
the deviation records a causal event rather than generic instability
dramatic_operations: record absence or damage through relation
convert formal deviation into state evidence
cinematic_affordances: matching objects with one missing, damaged, or reassigned
sound or movement asymmetry reinforcing the changed state
cultural_scope: general relational structure; symmetry does not carry fixed moral meaning
transferable_structure: an established balanced relation is altered so the formal difference becomes evidence of a causal state change
non_transferable_surface: copied twins, hallways, centered rooms, or arbitrary crooked compositions
